# [Implementation] - Task Plan

## 1. Context

- Smoke section extracted from the archived #284 plan at #364; the body is omitted.

### Manual Smoke Test Protocol

Precondition: run from the repository root after `npm run build`. Nothing here mutates the repo — every check uses a throwaway workspace under the tool's own sanctioned smoke sandbox, `$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-284-*`.

> **Sandbox choice (corrected after the first gate run).** `/tmp` is refused by `FileStateRepository.validateSmokeTestIsolation` rule 3 (`src/infrastructure/file-state-repository.ts:246-252`, pre-existing #279): a state target under `os.tmpdir()` is rejected outside test mode, so every state-mutating step aborts. The only path the predicate recognises as its own sandbox is `$HOME/.cache/agyloop` (`resolveSmokeSandboxRoot`, `:288-294`). These scenarios therefore `mktemp -d "$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-284-XXXXXX"`; each task uses its own directory and the run removes it afterwards.

**S1 — A PASSED gate writes its verdict, build system and test count (AC1, AC2).**

```bash
ROOT="$PWD"; SANDBOX="$HOME/.cache/agyloop"; mkdir -p "$SANDBOX"; WS="$(mktemp -d "$SANDBOX/smoke-284-XXXXXX")"; cd "$WS"
git init -q && git config user.email s@t && git config user.name s
printf 'x\n' > README.md && git add -A && git commit -qm 'chore: seed'
mkdir -p .agyloop/tasks artifacts/plans/284-smoke
cat > artifacts/plans/284-smoke/implementation_plan.md <<'PLAN'
# [Implementation] - Smoke
- [ ] Step 1: probe
PLAN
cp "$ROOT/templates/summary-log.md" "artifacts/plans/284-smoke/CodeLoop Summary.md"
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
now="2026-10-26T12:00:00.000Z"
json.dump({"version":"1.0.0","currentStage":"QUALITY_GATE","mode":"standard","issue":284,
  "baseBranch":"main","planDir":"artifacts/plans/284-smoke","createdAt":now,"updatedAt":now,
  "history":[{"stage":"QUALITY_GATE","timestamp":now}],"pausedAtGate":None,
  "pausedAtTimestamp":None,"totalHumanWaitMs":0},
  open(".agyloop/tasks/284.json","w"), indent=2)
PY
cat > gate.json <<'JSON'
GATE_REPORT_JSON:
{ "verdict": "PASSED", "buildSystem": "node", "buildStatus": "PASSED",
  "testsStatus": "PASSED (1408 passed)", "testsPassed": 1408, "testsFailed": 0,
  "durationMs": 196000, "executedCommands": ["npm run lint", "npm test"],
  "smokeProtocol": "PASSED", "notRun": [] }
JSON
node "$ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" gate-report --issue 284 --report-file gate.json
node "$ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" transition REVIEW --issue 284 --workspace "$WS" --no-worktree
grep -n "Build System\|Build Status\|Tests:" "artifacts/plans/284-smoke/CodeLoop Summary.md"
grep -n "4. Quality Gate" "artifacts/plans/284-smoke/CodeLoop Summary.md"
```

Expected:
```
✓ Gate evidence recorded: PASSED — node — PASSED (1408 passed) — 3m 16s
  Evidence: $HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-284-…/.agyloop/tasks/284.gate.json
  Next: codeloop transition REVIEW --issue 284
- **Build System:** node
- **Build Status:** PASSED
- **Tests:** PASSED (1408 passed)
| 4. Quality Gate | `gate` | `flash_lite` | COMPLETED | 3m 16s |
```

**S2 — A gate with no filed evidence says `not recorded`, never `PENDING` (AC2).**

```bash
ROOT="$PWD"; SANDBOX="$HOME/.cache/agyloop"; mkdir -p "$SANDBOX"; WS="$(mktemp -d "$SANDBOX/smoke-284-XXXXXX")"; cd "$WS"
git init -q && git config user.email s@t && git config user.name s
printf 'x\n' > README.md && git add -A && git commit -qm 'chore: seed'
mkdir -p .agyloop/tasks artifacts/plans/285-smoke
cat > artifacts/plans/285-smoke/implementation_plan.md <<'PLAN'
# [Implementation] - Smoke
- [ ] Step 1: probe
PLAN
cp "$ROOT/templates/summary-log.md" "artifacts/plans/285-smoke/CodeLoop Summary.md"
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
now="2026-10-26T12:00:00.000Z"
json.dump({"version":"1.0.0","currentStage":"QUALITY_GATE","mode":"standard","issue":285,
  "baseBranch":"main","planDir":"artifacts/plans/285-smoke","createdAt":now,"updatedAt":now,
  "history":[{"stage":"QUALITY_GATE","timestamp":now}],"pausedAtGate":None,
  "pausedAtTimestamp":None,"totalHumanWaitMs":0},
  open(".agyloop/tasks/285.json","w"), indent=2)
PY
node "$ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" transition REVIEW --issue 285 --workspace "$WS" --no-worktree
grep -n "Build Status\|Tests:" "artifacts/plans/285-smoke/CodeLoop Summary.md"
grep -n "4. Quality Gate" "artifacts/plans/285-smoke/CodeLoop Summary.md"
grep -q "Build Status:\*\* PENDING" "artifacts/plans/285-smoke/CodeLoop Summary.md" && echo "DEFECT PRESENT" || echo "NO PENDING BUILD STATUS — correct"
grep -q "Build Status:\*\* not recorded" "artifacts/plans/285-smoke/CodeLoop Summary.md" && echo "NOT RECORDED PRESENT — correct"
grep -q "Tests:\*\* not recorded" "artifacts/plans/285-smoke/CodeLoop Summary.md" && echo "TESTS NOT RECORDED — correct"
```

> The `PENDING` sentinel above is necessary but not sufficient on its own: the honest template already ships `not recorded`, so the two positive assertions are what prove the writer actually emitted the value rather than leaving the template untouched.

Expected: a warning naming `codeloop gate-report`, then
```
- **Build Status:** not recorded
- **Tests:** not recorded
| 4. Quality Gate | `gate` | `flash_lite` | NOT RECORDED | - |
NO PENDING BUILD STATUS — correct
```
(Other stage rows may legitimately still read `PENDING` at this point — the `COMPLETED`-task rule is S7.)

**S6 — `sync` refuses to close an issue on a test-only PR (AC12).**

```bash
ROOT="$PWD"; SANDBOX="$HOME/.cache/agyloop"; mkdir -p "$SANDBOX"; WS="$(mktemp -d "$SANDBOX/smoke-284-XXXXXX")"; cd "$WS"
git init -q && git config user.email s@t && git config user.name s
printf 'x\n' > README.md && git add -A && git commit -qm 'chore: seed'
git checkout -qb phase/6-smoke
mkdir -p .agyloop/tasks .bin
cat > .bin/gh <<'SH'
#!/bin/sh
case "$*" in
  *"pr list"*)  echo '[{"number":9,"title":"t","body":"Closes #250"}]' ;;
  *"pr view"*)  echo '{"files":[{"path":"tests/x.test.ts"}]}' ;;
  *"issue view"*) echo '{"number":250,"title":"t","body":"b","state":"OPEN","labels":[],"milestone":null}' ;;
  *"issue close"*) echo "CLOSED $*" >> gh-calls.log ;;
  *) echo '' ;;
esac
SH
chmod +x .bin/gh
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
now="2026-10-26T12:00:00.000Z"
json.dump({"version":"1.0.0","currentStage":"COMPLETED","mode":"standard","issue":250,
  "baseBranch":"phase/6-smoke","createdAt":now,"updatedAt":now,
  "history":[{"stage":"COMPLETED","timestamp":now}],"totalHumanWaitMs":0},
  open(".agyloop/tasks/250.json","w"), indent=2)
PY
PATH="$WS/.bin:$PATH" node "$ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" sync --issue 250 2>&1 | tail -8
test ! -f gh-calls.log && echo "NO CLOSE CALL — correct"
```

Expected: the sync result lists a warning `Not closing #250: PR #9 contains no non-test source change`, and the final line `NO CLOSE CALL — correct` (no `issue close` invocation was made).

**S7 — The commit gate reports what it did: untracked file listed, PR URL printed, no manual script, no `PENDING` left behind (AC2, AC10, AC11, AC12).**

```bash
ROOT="$PWD"; SANDBOX="$HOME/.cache/agyloop"; mkdir -p "$SANDBOX"; WS="$(mktemp -d "$SANDBOX/smoke-284-XXXXXX")"; cd "$WS"

printf '.agyloop/\nartifacts/\n' > .gitignore
printf 'x\n' > README.md && git add -A && git commit -qm 'chore: seed'
git checkout -qb task/289
git init -q --bare "$WS.origin.git" && git remote add origin "$WS.origin.git"
mkdir -p .agyloop/tasks artifacts/plans/289-smoke tests
STUB="$(mktemp -d "$SANDBOX/gh-stub-284-XXXXXX")"
printf 'probe\n' > tests/new.test.ts
printf 'x\ny\n' > README.md
cat > artifacts/plans/289-smoke/implementation_plan.md <<'PLAN'
# [Implementation] - Smoke
- [ ] Step 1: probe
PLAN
cp "$ROOT/templates/summary-log.md" "artifacts/plans/289-smoke/CodeLoop Summary.md"

#!/bin/sh
case "$*" in

  *"pr create"*) echo "https://example.test/pull/9" ;;
  *"pr view"*) echo "https://example.test/pull/9" ;;
  *) echo '' ;;
esac
SH
chmod +x "$STUB/gh"
python3 - "$WS" <<'PY'

ws=sys.argv[1]
t0=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
iso=lambda d: d.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z')
json.dump({"version":"1.0.0","currentStage":"COMMIT","mode":"standard","issue":289,

  "worktree":{"taskId":"289","worktreePath":ws,"branch":"task/289",

  "history":[{"stage":"COMMIT","timestamp":iso(t0-datetime.timedelta(seconds=84))}],
  "pausedAtGate":"COMMIT","pausedAtTimestamp":iso(t0-datetime.timedelta(seconds=84)),
  "totalHumanWaitMs":0},

PY
OUT="$(PATH="$STUB:$PATH" node "$ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" commit --issue 289 -y --create-pr --workspace "$WS" 2>&1)"
printf '%s\n' "$OUT"
grep -n "Files to commit\|untracked\|PR created\|Next Step\|Closing keyword\|Closes #289" <<<"$OUT"
grep -n "6. Commit Gate\|Build Status" "artifacts/plans/289-smoke/CodeLoop Summary.md"
if grep -q "PENDING" "artifacts/plans/289-smoke/CodeLoop Summary.md"; then echo "PENDING PRESENT — DEFECT"; else echo "0 PENDING — correct"; fi
grep -c "Commit Message" "artifacts/plans/289-smoke/CodeLoop Summary.md"
```

```
Files to commit (2):
  - README.md
  - tests/new.test.ts (untracked)

✓ Pipeline advanced to COMPLETED.
```
